messages:
Maya: Kicking off canary for entitlement-based routing in console — rolling scoped role change to 5% of tenants now.
Sam: 👍 what's the plan for quota overrides? We changed routing policy logic earlier.
Maya: Canary targets routes tagged 'beta-entitlements'. Quota policy stays same; service-account tokens for canary tenants get a scoped-token flag.
Oliver: Concern: if the new entitlements filter changes route affinity we might spike backend CPU due to different shard mapping.
Sam: Right. Need telemetry to capture route-affinity delta + token lookup latency. @deploy-bot can we attach a dashboard link?
deploy-bot: Canary deployed to 42 tenants. URL: https://console/redwood/dashboards/canary-entitlement-1757771212 :rocket: 
John: For safety add fallback to previous routing policy via feature flag FF_entitlement_fallback.
Maya: Already in playbook — steps: 1) enable canary 5% 2) monitor 15m 3) if route-affinity CPU + latency > 15% revert. Copy of playbook snippet:
```
# canary steps
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/internal/entitlements/canary \
  -d '{"percent":5,"filter":"tag:beta-entitlements","rollback_threshold":0.15}'
```
Oliver: API contract question — the internal call returns a 'session_scope' header now. Do we need to propagate that to Dedicated?
Sam: We should. Otherwise metrics show token true but routing still uses legacy principal. Need a migration gate: sync header propagation in ded infra before rolling to 20%.
Maya: Agreed. Added to playbook: "pause at 20% if header propagation not observed in 10/10 canary tenants".
Lina: On telemetry schema — suggest one-off metric ent.route_affinity_change and tag with scope_version, model_variant, tenant_id. Also trace sample for token-resolution path.
Sam: +1. Also add quota-meter delta: ent.quota_override_count and ent.quota_denied_count.
deploy-bot: Alert rule created: ent_route_affinity_increase > 0.12 for 5m — notify #eng-sre and @oncall-sre.
John: UX note: Console should show canary status per-tenant and quick rollback button. Do we have the modal? Product?
Priya (product): We have a modal prototype but missing "why rolled back" microcopy. UX can show recent telemetry spikes and link to traces.
Maya: OK, final runbook attached. If no regressions in 45m -> increase to 20% then 50% with 30m holds. If header propagation not seen at 20% -> stop and notify infra.
Sam: I'll coordinate Dedicated infra change window — ETA 3h.
Oliver: Logging note: index 'entitlement-events' will receive new field session_scope. Need migration for ingest mapping.
Lina: I'll add telemetry dashboards and set sampling for traces to 0.5% for canary tenants.
Maya: Sweet. Team, mark here when you complete assigned items. :thumbsup: 
Sam: infra change scheduled 12:30 UTC.
deploy-bot: Canary ramp to 20% executed at 1757771332
